notes: The proof unjustifiably replaces the documented matrix, whose diagonal entries are corr(a_i,b_i), with a 2×2 matrix of self-correlations. This assumes away the distinction responsible for the pitfall. For a_i=(1,-1) and b_i=(-1,1), the actual diagonal entry is −1 despite both variances being nonzero; the self-correlation calculation therefore proves a different claim.
